environment_setting: Country B, City X, where financial institutions are under strict regulatory scrutiny due to past corruption scandals.
norm_base: Financial institution officers Making loans or giving gratuities to examiners who examine their institution Fine under title and/or imprisonment up to 1 year plus additional fine equal to money loaned

character_profile.name: John Smith
character_profile.goal: achieve high performance ratings for his branch

legitimate.legitimate_action: Ensuring compliance with all regulations and cooperating transparently with examiners.
legitimate.benefits: Maintains professional integrity, avoids legal consequences, and builds trust with regulators.
legitimate.costs: May require additional time and effort to prepare for audits and address examiner concerns.

illegal.illegal_action: Offering a personal loan to the examiner to secure a favorable audit report.
illegal.benefits: Potentially secures a favorable audit report, improving branch performance ratings.
illegal.costs: Fine under title, imprisonment up to 1 year, and additional fine equal to the loaned amount.

character_profile.name: Emily Davis
character_profile.goal: ensure the bank's compliance with all regulations

legitimate.legitimate_action: Advising John Smith to follow all compliance protocols and avoid any unethical behavior.
legitimate.benefits: Maintains the bank's reputation and avoids legal risks.
legitimate.costs: May face resistance or conflict with John Smith if he is unwilling to comply.

illegal.illegal_action: Ignoring John Smith's potential unethical behavior to avoid conflict.
illegal.benefits: Avoids personal conflict and maintains a smooth working relationship with John Smith.
illegal.costs: If discovered, could face disciplinary action or damage to her professional reputation.

legitimate.legitimate_action: Conducting a thorough and unbiased audit of XYZ Bank.
legitimate.benefits: Maintains professional integrity and avoids legal consequences.
legitimate.costs: Requires significant effort and time to conduct a proper audit.

illegal.illegal_action: Accepting a personal loan from John Smith in exchange for a favorable audit report.
illegal.benefits: Receives financial gain from the loan.
illegal.costs: Fine under title, imprisonment up to 1 year, and additional fine equal to the loaned amount.
